definitions.explanation: General knowledge and intellectual cultivation acquired through education and cultural exposure, often implying a well-rounded education.

examples.japanese: {教養|きょうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00060_hito⟧。
{教養|きょうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{身|み}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00556_tsukeru⟧。
{教養|きょうよう}{番組|ばんぐみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。

notes:
{教養|きょうよう} refers to general knowledge, intellectual cultivation, and refinement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教養|きょうよう}がある (to be cultured/educated)
- {教養|きょうよう}を{身|み}に{付|つ}ける (to acquire education/culture)
- {教養|きょうよう}{課程|かてい} (general education curriculum)
- {教養|きょうよう}{番組|ばんぐみ} (educational program)

RELATED TERMS:
- {一般|いっぱん}{教養|きょうよう}: general education
- ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：02949_kyouiku⟧: education (more formal/institutional)
- {学識|がくしき}: scholarly knowledge
- {知識|ちしき}: knowledge
